scope: Illustrative live UI evidence; not an additional research experiment or a modification of frozen results.
model: Existing pretrained MobileNetV3-Large, CPU Kubernetes pods
demo_traffic: One real image request plus 24 low-rate synthetic connectivity requests to show telemetry; separate from registered experiments.
interpretation: Single image prediction scores are not model accuracy measurements. Live p95 is a histogram estimate, not the exact frozen CSV quantile. Historical audit banners refer to 306 tests / 1420 outcomes, while current repository validation has 345 tests. CPU-mode CUDA VRAM is zero.
